words.sense: continuing toward a goal despite difficulty
misconceptions: all refusal to stop is persistence

words.sense: unreasonably refusing to change despite good reason

semantic_axes.description: whether someone updates a method after strong reasons
whether continuing the current approach remains reasonable

edges.boundary_rule: Persistence keeps the goal while adapting; obstinacy refuses to change despite good reason.

beats.text: After two trays of seedlings fail, Rafi adjusts the watering with advice from a gardener and starts another tray.
beats.reason: He continues while adapting to useful advice.

hints.attention: How does the person respond to a useful reason to change?
hints.axis: Look at adaptability, not just continued effort.
hints.contrast: Continuing toward a goal can include changing the method.

chains.feedback_short: Rafi changes the method and keeps pursuing the goal.
chains.feedback_deep: He treats failure as a reason to adjust the watering, not as a reason to abandon the seedlings.
chains.contrast_rule: Persistence keeps the goal while adapting; obstinacy refuses to change despite good reason.

beats.text: A technician demonstrates that her chosen format loses words, so Isha accepts a different format and carries on.

beats.text: A colleague calls the project a waste of time, but gives no new reason; Isha follows the workable revised plan.
